answer: Stain every emission with a pigment tracing the identity that earned it, and let the stain travel whenever the funds move. One honest agent's rewards arrive a single colour; a farm consolidating dozens of clones at one wharf arrives as a saffron mix of many stains in a single wallet, visible to everyone. Discount or quarantine merged-stain balances until each contributing identity is separately re-verified. Consolidation, the step every farm must take to use its gains, becomes the exposure rather than the escape.
